trigger.reason: The first combined audit still rejected because stack_blocks_two had no train failure support. Extending only that task would also leave a 5x task imbalance.

selection.rule: For every non-hammer task, retain every source scene not already present in the frozen base manifest, regardless of outcome.

result: Together with the immutable base and hammer supplement, the train split has exactly 100 trajectories for each of six tasks.
constraints: No eval-split scene or outcome is admitted to training.
No outcome-dependent stopping or filtering is permitted.
The two East shards have disjoint task sets and result roots.
R4 training remains unauthorized until the original outcome audit and the three-camera query audit both accept.
